buildStatus: development; not a replacement for the official installation

cases.passCondition: Keyboard-only use works; cancel leaves draft/context unchanged.
Existing binding is identified; no silent reassignment.
Unrelated shortcuts and terminal input retain existing behavior.
One insertion at the captured editor selection; surrounding text and attachments survive.
Stale insertion is rejected or offers explicit append; new typing is not overwritten.
No insertion into the newly focused destination and no automatic navigation.
Only one insertion and one usage increment.
Action prepares a draft only; no queue, steer, or agent turn starts.
Clear validation/availability message; no guessed or silently empty context.
Changes persist; stale edits fail safely; deleted/disabled direct actions do not run.
Valid standalone text format round-trips; fork-only data is not silently exported as portable.
Imported code/unknown builders are rejected; read-only authorization cannot edit server actions or send tasks.
Same checkout, branch, model, transcript, and supported operations after migration.
Both bindings survive reload; one conversation owns the task.
Returns selectable repositories, not an automatically authorized workspace.
Correct canonical identity; no duplicate checkout binding.
Distinct checkout identity; no accidental collapse based on URL.
Identified as a Git checkout without requiring a `.git` directory.
Rejected or requires explicit authorized selection; no silent broadened access.
Ownership and excluded paths are explicit; no parent operation silently mutates a child.
Bounded/cancellable discovery; truncation and skipped areas are reported.
No switch, reset, stash, or discard; unrelated work remains.
Uses the approved base commit, not an assumed copy of uncommitted source changes.
Reuses only an explicitly selected eligible worktree or stops with an explanation.
Correct working directories reach the agent and every file/Git UI.
Other results remain visible; retry does not duplicate successful worktrees.
Durable reconciliation discovers the result and safely resumes or reports repair.
Stops further work; created resources are reported and cleaned only under ownership/safety rules.
No script execution or secret copying without the defined approval.
Agent edits both approved paths; permission prompts retain the correct host/path scope.
Multi-repo launch is blocked; existing single-repo support remains.
Same valid manifest and native provider context; no silent new session or substituted path.
Affected binding is unavailable/stale; mutation stops rather than targeting another checkout.
Membership change is refused; no mid-turn permission expansion.
Supported adapter updates explicitly; unsupported adapter leaves the existing thread unchanged.

cases.case: Same relative file in two repos
cases.passCondition: Diff tabs, editor links, and caches remain repository-qualified.
Other results stay usable; aggregate UI shows incomplete data, not “clean.”
Correct repo/branch/remote; link belongs to the matching binding and existing thread.
Successes and failures are recorded individually; uncertain writes are not blindly retried.

cases.case: PRs with identical numbers on different hosts/repos
cases.passCondition: Correct identity, status, context, and linked-thread behavior.
Existing watches work; one open/unresolved linked PR prevents false all-done settlement.
Unsupported aggregate file restore is disabled with a clear reason; eligible single-repo restore still works.
No deletion while another thread/terminal owns it or safety checks fail.
All bindings execute on the selected host; no local-path substitution or cross-host rebalance mid-task.
Current scoped draft gets context; thread/worktree count stays unchanged.
Same dispatcher and destination behavior as the compact row.
Same context builder and insertion behavior as buttons.
Separate choice retains the intended upstream handoff and preparation behavior.

cases.case: Global PR page without a destination
cases.passCondition: Asks to select a thread; does not guess the most recent one.
Explains mismatch; does not switch checkout or silently change destination.

cases.case: Missing, denied, stale, or truncated CI logs
cases.passCondition: Names the limitation; no fabricated log context or claim of complete failure analysis.
Prepared failure/commit association is invalidated or clearly refreshed.
No execution, arbitrary fetch, privilege change, or unsafe HTML rendering.

cases.case: Remote conflict versus local unmerged state
cases.passCondition: Context correctly distinguishes both; preparation starts no merge/rebase.
User content remains; only identical application-owned context is deduplicated.
No unauthorized insertion/send or silent thread revival; actionable state shown.
Profiles, homes, locks, services, and URL handlers do not collide.
Old transcripts decode; original backup remains usable; external assets are accounted for.
Stops safely; does not reset data or open it through an unsupported binary.
Correct accounts and homes on the execution host; managed login, CLI login, reauthorization, and account switching tested separately. No silent API-billing fallback.

cases.case: Direct Tailscale pairing with Connect disabled
cases.passCondition: Second device authenticates and uses the fork without a cloud route.
Chat, approvals, both repos, diffs, terminal, and PR operations use the intended host.
Resume/reconnect retains environment identity and does not duplicate agent work.
Access is rejected; credentials are not sent to a mismatched learned endpoint.
Coexisting installations cannot remove each other's route; no public exposure is enabled.
Changed controls and assets load over the paired HTTPS endpoint on desktop and phone browsers.
Exact tested versions recorded; unsupported multi-repo mutation fails safely; incompatibility is disclosed.
Separately marked passed/failed/not tested; public config is not treated as proof of native sign-in.
Tested through the configured cloud path or explicitly unavailable; Tailscale is not advertised as their replacement.
Uses the owned fork artifacts or says manual update; no upstream fallback replacement.
Matching fork runtime, correct platform, verified checksum, isolated ownership.

Existing single-repo browser/tools, skills, approvals, PR links, queue/steer, and supported restore remain functional. Record native-helper, clipboard, notification, and OS-permission results under the fork identity.
